scientific_integrity: Analytical proof with supplementary reproducible numerical checks; no independent validation asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite cyclic two-dimensional grids with mean-zero Fourier coefficient and fixed relative first-difference energy; fixed-energy asymptotics do not apply uniformly to variable budgets. No sensor-recovery implication is established. Bibliographic equivalents in unindexed older spectral optimization literature are not excluded.
title: Sharp fixed-energy Fourier-ratio frontier and a four-mode condensate on square grids
